'''Version 1.3.0''' was an update for the Scape and Run: Parasites Mod, released on November 9th 2019.  It was 610.13 KB.

== ''Change Log'' ==
Changed base values for the following mobs:

* [[Primitive Longarms|'''Shyco''']]:
*# Base Health: 120-> 90
*# Base Armor: 10 -> 8
*# Base Damage: 5.7 -> 5
*# Base KD Resistance: 1.5 -> 1

* [[Adapted Summoner|'''Canra''']]
*# Base Health: 150 -> 50
*# Base Armor: 15 -> 7
*# Base Damage: 6.8 -> 5
*# Base KD Resistance: 1.8 -> 1

* Changed "Shyco" name for "[[Primitive Longarms|Primitive Shyco]]"
* Changed "Nogla" name for "[[Primitive Reeker|Primitive Nogla]]"
* Changed "Hull" name for "[[Primitive Manducater|Primitive Hull]]"
* Changed "Emana" name for "[[Primitive Yelloweye|Primitive Emana]]"
* Changed "Canra" name for "[[Adapted Summoner|Adapted Canra]]"
* Changed "Dorpa" name for "[[Assimilated Big Spider|Infected Dorpa]]"
* Changed texture for the Hull
* Changed model for Nogla
* Changed how many [[Buglin|Lodos]] the [[Assimilated Human|infected human]] can spawn when hurt (2 -> 1)
* The [[Heavy Carrier|Rathol]] can now explote when its health is below 5%
* The infected Human now has a new animation

==== <u>New Content</u> ====

* Added an adapted version for the following mobs:
*# Primitive Shyco
*# Primitive Nogla
*# Primitive Hull

* Added a [[Primitive Summoner|primitive version]] for the Canra mob
* [[:Category:Primitive_Parasites|Primitive]] mobs can change their form when they get x amount of kills
* The [[Manducater (Disambiguation)|Hull]] branch can have Invisibility, only if they have full health
* The [[Longarms (Disambiguation)|Shyco]] branch have a chance to reflect a portion of damage
* The [[Summoner (Disambiguation)|Canra]] branch have a chance to summon mobs
* The [[Reeker (Disambiguation)|Nogla]] branch can poison its target
* Added custom spawners
